row: Equine Performance and Rehab at UTCVM

The Equine Performance and Rehabilitation Center at the University of Tennessee College of Veterinary Medicine is a state of the art facility that provides advanced lameness diagnostics, treatments and rehabilitation of the horse. Visit us at https://equinerehab.utk.edu or visit us on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/UTEPRC/
